claim: For the normalized Case II piecewise-linear Clapp oscillator of Petržela with \(y_{11}=1\), \(y_{12}=1/10\), and outer transconductance slope \(a\in[-10,-1]\), the two outer equilibria have the same characteristic polynomial \[q_a(\lambda)=\lambda^4+\lambda^3+(3-a/10)\lambda^2+(a+21/10)\lambda-a/10.\] Let \(P(a)=192a^5-1380360a^4-11138818a^3-29595555a^2-44649090a-24931935\). There are exactly two discriminant roots in this interval, \(\alpha\approx-4.871964811954576\) and \(\beta\approx-1.009024344776341\), and the unique stability crossing is \(a_H=(-131-\sqrt{100321})/220\approx-2.035158658765436\). For \(-10\le a<\alpha\), each outer equilibrium has two positive real eigenvalues and one stable complex pair; for \(\alpha<a<a_H\), it has one unstable and one stable complex pair; for \(a_H<a<\beta\), it has two stable complex pairs; and for \(\beta<a\le-1\), it has one stable complex pair and two negative real eigenvalues. At \(a=\alpha\) a positive real pair coalesces, at \(a=a_H\) a simple imaginary pair occurs with \(\omega=\sqrt{(331-\sqrt{100321})/220}\), and at \(a=\beta\) a stable complex pair coalesces into two negative real eigenvalues. Thus the source's two-threshold summary near \(-2\) and \(-1\) misses the earlier real-to-complex transition near \(-4.872\) and can be sharpened to an exact four-regime spectral partition. This is a local linear statement and does not identify the mechanism of the reported chaos-hyperchaos transitions.
integrity: The characteristic polynomial is taken from the source's stated outer-equilibrium substitution. Exact Routh-Hurwitz and Sturm-sequence calculations establish the stability and real/complex root partition; decimal values are only readable enclosures.
scientific limitations: Local spectral classification only on the normalized Case II slice with y11=1, y12=1/10 and outer slope in [-10,-1]; no nonlinear Hopf criticality, chaos mechanism, basin classification, or existence theorem is claimed.
title: Exact outer-equilibrium spectral partition in the PWL Clapp oscillator
